name: double_stage_scroll_expander
title: Two-stage hermetic scroll expander (correlation model)
summary: Correlation model of the two-stage hermetic scroll expander of Lemort, Quoilin and Pire: filling factor and stage isentropic effectiveness as polynomial fits in ln(r_p) and ln(rho_su) applied to each stage, swept volumes of both stages from the imposed mass flow, and the intermediate pressure ratio solved from the zero-derivative condition xi = d(epsilon_overall)/d(r_p_1) = 0. Originally written as an EES MODULE; the equations are flattened into the main program (library decision D10).

origin.course: ULiège laboratory correlation model (30 September 2010), based on the Lemort/Quoilin/Pire hermetic scroll expander measurements

verification.reference: EES stored solution of the source file (module variables compared under their flattened '_mod' names; 54 common variables). Variables cleared in the EES store are compared with the guess values EES kept from its last solve; epsilon_overall, V_s_1_mod and V_s_2_mod were cleared without guess and are compared with values recomputed from the stored enthalpies, filling factors and densities
verification.notes: Root cause of every deviation: the R245fa property difference between EES 8.652 (2010) and CoolProp at the fixed state T_sat = 130 C (p_sat 0.44 %, supply density 0.88 %, enthalpy 0.04 %), amplified by the correlation polynomials to 0.16-0.18 % on the effectiveness values and up to 3.12e-02 on the derivative diagnostics (der_rp_epsilon_2_mod); enthalpies, entropies, betas and W_dot_exp_1_mod agree within 1e-3 (ees_import.md §11, older EES fluid models: up to a few %, explained).

related_external: V. Lemort, S. Quoilin and C. Pire, Experimental Investigation on a Hermetic Scroll Expander, 7th International Conference on Compressors (as cited in the source file)

history.action: added (roadmap card C-128, batch B-10; MODULE flattened per decision D10)
